clues.text: Before leaving on a journey, a master gave his servants five, two and one of these, each by ability.
In Jesus' parable, a fearful servant dug a hole and hid his master's single one of these in the ground.
In Jesus' parable of a king settling accounts, a debtor owing ten thousand of these was brought before him.
The queen of Sheba gave King Solomon 120 of these in gold, with spices and precious stones.
Naaman insisted that Elisha's servant Gehazi take two of these in silver, tied up in two bags.
Haman offered to put ten thousand of these in silver into King Xerxes' treasury to destroy the Jews.
Every year, gold weighing 666 of these came in to King Solomon.
